mysql-connector-python

dateutil
pyspark
prettytable
jsonpickle
pyarrow
pymysql
dbt-core
docker
pyorc
PyYAML
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes all detected imports with their standard PyPI package names. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image, sets up the working directory, installs the dependencies from requirements.txt, copies the application code, and sets the default command to run a Python script (replace 'your_script.py' with your actual entry point).
